authority.purpose: Operational working map for staged JANUS cross-repository integration.

three_graph_model.HABITAT_GRAPH: existence, memory, discovery and reciprocal handoff topology; link is not authority
three_graph_model.NEXUS_GRAPH: typed explicitly admitted transport; type compatibility alone is not a route; route is not delivery or authority
three_graph_model.EPISTEMIC_PROOF_GRAPH: claim-class routing to bounded verifiers/providers; provider PASS is not world truth

integration_sequence.name: NEXUS_V2_COSMOS_TYPED_PROOF_EDGE
integration_sequence.rule: Do not modify frozen Nexus v1; create v2 candidate with exact typed routes and frozen contract before implementation.

integration_sequence.name: SKINGPT_OBSERVATION_EDGE
integration_sequence.rule: Only normalized observation receipts; no safety, injury or calibrated-probability authority without evidence.

integration_sequence.name: SWARM_EDGE_OBSERVATION_EDGE
integration_sequence.rule: Observer/telemetry semantics only; stale/degraded state remains visible; no ambient submit or command authority.

integration_sequence.name: AIFC_WITNESS_PACKAGE_EDGE
integration_sequence.rule: Witness/freeze/causal evidence package remains distinct from truth, permission and provider execution.

integration_sequence.name: I0_MEASUREMENT_RECEIPT_EDGE
integration_sequence.rule: Measurement receipt preserves UNKNOWN for missing sensors and never promotes hash integrity into source truth.
